name: Become Familiar (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Animal Patron

Major Hex: The witch can become the same kind of animal as her familiar. For a number of minutes per day equal to her level, the witch can become the same type of Tiny animal as her familiar, as per beast shape II. These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1-minute increments.
